title: atlas.assertion.read.v1 — arguments
description: Read specific assertions whether or not they are still believed, optionally with their lineage. An id compaction reclaimed returns a typed atlas.error:v1 carrying the reclamation note — never a bare not-found, because a dangling reference and a typo must not look the same.

include_lineage.description: Also return what each assertion supersedes and what superseded it, one hop in each direction.
